action_instruction: Calculating actual risk against the risk budget
intent: the difference between the actual risk shown in the result panel and the risk budget calculated from the account balance and Risk per trade field

action_params.condition: the actual risk shown is not greater than the risk budget the page shows under the "Risk per trade" field (balance 10000 multiplied by 0.3% is $30.00 rounded to the cent)
action_params.query: the difference between the actual risk shown in the result panel and the risk budget calculated from the account balance and Risk per trade field

action_instruction: Reading the position size from the result panel
intent: the position size shown in the Position size result panel

action_params.condition: the Result panel shows a position size of exactly 100.0 SOL
action_params.query: the position size shown in the Position size result panel

action_instruction: Reading the actual risk from the result panel
intent: the actual risk amount shown in the Position size result panel

action_params.condition: the actual risk shown is exactly $30.00
action_params.query: the actual risk amount shown in the Position size result panel

assertion_tree.description: the Result panel shows a position size of exactly 100.0 SOL, the actual risk shown is exactly $30.00, and the actual risk shown is not greater than the risk budget the page shows under the "Risk per trade" field (balance 10000 multiplied by 0.3% is $30.00 rounded to the cent)
